name: The Sailboat
trigger: Teams struggling to decouple their aspirational product goals from current technical drag, organizational dependencies, and impending environmental risks.
canvasLine: 4 Zones: Island, Wind, Anchors, Rocks · 60–90 min

steps.text: Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive; name the target Island.
Gather data (20m): five minutes per zone: Wind, Anchors, Rocks, then the Island.
Generate insights (20m): cluster notes; dot-vote the heaviest Anchors and Rocks.
Decide (15m): sever one Anchor before adding Wind; name its owner.
Close (5m): affirm navigation capability and capture the ROTI.

action: An Anchor becomes a systemic initiative: parallel CI under 15 minutes instead of 90; owner, date.
provenance: Source protocol: the phases and minutes follow the written sequence in the source.

origin.note: Common retro metaphor; no documented originator.
